content.title: BHP Ends New Anglo Takeover Bid After Rejection
content.summary: The regulatory statement followed a Bloomberg News report on Sunday that BHP — which had already failed in a bid for Anglo last year — made a new overture in recent days.  Anglo rejected that new approach, according to people familiar with the situation, having reviewed the proposal and decided that it was not superior to the combination with Teck.  The mining giant’s overture comes just weeks before shareholders from Anglo and Teck are scheduled to vote on their own deal to create a company worth more than $60 billion, — effectively putting two long-coveted, copper-rich targets further out of reach.
